lead.fr: On capture une idée, une note ou un vocal en vrac et on la perd, ou on ne la retrouve pas structurée. lead.en: You capture an idea, a note or a voice memo on the fly and then you lose it, or you can't find it in any usable shape. DUMP is a cognitive assistant: you speak or type, messy and unfiltered, and the AI sorts it automatically. Especially handy for minds that overflow with ideas and scatter easily (ADHD included), as an everyday organization tool. I built it for myself first.
